n: Day of AI: How We Teach Machines
t: A device-free Day of AI unit on how machines use data to make predictions.
steps: Go to dayofai.org and look for the How We Teach Machines unit.
Note that the unit page returned an error when the research team fetched it. The vendor details may have moved.
Register or log in. Other Day of AI units ask for registration.
Download the slides and the educator guide when they are offered.
Print any student pages for Dataset Sort.
Read the three lessons and plan one or two sessions.
Check the grade range on the unit page. The research team did not see an age label.
